name: capture_browser_scenario
description: Run a controlled browser scenario when passive observation cannot exercise the application. Launch the selected executable or connect to a loopback CDP target, provide a start URL and actions, and select storage or artifacts when needed. Environment, empty storage, and a URL-only final capture are defaults. capture.network selects request_body, response_body, and header_values independently; selected content is returned inline with transaction and event references, byte digests, and explicit unavailable states. Credentials and declared secrets are redacted. Agents can run their own local fixture servers to control application responses. Actions run until completion or cancellation unless timeout_ms is set. Results are returned inline.

mode.description: Operation mode that selects the requested behavior.

executable_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the browser executable; relative paths are rejected.

headless.description: Run without a visible browser window; defaults to true and can be disabled when the host supports a display.

browser.description: Required launch/connect selection. Launch uses the selected executable and an owned temporary profile; connect uses one loopback CDP endpoint and target.

start_url.description: Required initial HTTP(S) URL. Query values must be declared separately as public literals or secret references.

environment.description: Optional deterministic browser settings. Defaults to 1280x720, en-US, UTC, light mode, reduced motion, and blocked service workers.

timeout_ms.description: Optional action deadline in milliseconds; omitted means wait until completion or request cancellation.
